name: zrndr_global_string_table_load_dynamic_entries_from_path
description: zRndr_GlobalStringTable::LoadDynamicEntriesFromPath loads a ZRD string-list array and appends unknown prefixes to the global render string table until capacity.
known_limits: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x481460 still shows the first-child array extraction and copied-string loop as low-level value-offset and repne/memcpy idioms; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zRndr global-string-table/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x481460 validates the null-path and load-failure returns, first child array extraction, loop over string entries starting at index 1, duplicate-prefix check through zReader::FindGlobalStringPrefixIndex, 100-entry capacity stop, private malloc copy, and zReader::FreeLoadedTree after processed lists.

The native smoke uses a mounted ZRD archive, verifies existing prefixes are skipped, new entries are copied into the global table in order, and a later whitespace-delimited duplicate of a newly added prefix is skipped.
